messages:
siva: Heads up — since ~03:12 UTC we're seeing a spike in BMC OOB firmware failures for the AP-SE GPU canary pool. Failure rate ~12% on the canary shards, provisioning backlog jumping and GPU alloc latencies >3x.
kevin: Oncall looking. Which firmware image and which batch?
siva: Image: fw-bmc-2025-03-12-v3. Batch job id: j-98421. Canary nodes: ap-se1-rack{3,4,7}. Logs show `flash write timeout` and `i2c NACK` interleaved.
maria: I pulled serial for one failed host — console shows repeated `BMC: watchdog reset` during post-flash verification. Suspect the new power sequencing in v3.
elena: Pausing the rollout ASAP. @deploy-bot can you hold the remaining gates for j-98421? :warning:
deploy-bot: Automated action: rollout j-98421 moved to state=PAUSED by request of @elena at 03:18 UTC.
kevin: Good call. Reverting canary cluster to prior image? We should avoid mass rollback but canary revert if safe.
siva: Revert attempted on rack3, host bmc1 — manual flash to fw-bmc-2025-02-28 succeeded. GPU provisioning for that host recovered.
maria: Pasted the short tail from the failed flash log:
```
[03:14:02] flash: write 0x3f800 timeout
[03:14:02] i2c-aux: device 0x28 NACK
[03:14:03] watchdog: reset due to FRU checksum mismatch
[03:14:05] bmc: firmware verification failed (err -5)
```
kevin: That i2c NACK pattern looks hardware-timed. Could be the new sequence toggling a bus with a slow peripheral. Need vendor confirm. Opening vendor ticket.
elena: Also we are seeing spillover provisioning in ap-se1 -> requests routed to eu-west1 and usw2. Cost alert triggered for cross-region egress & reserved capacity usage. Finance FYI: @maria can you estimate delta?
maria: Quick ballpark: cross-region attach & prewarm ~ +$6k/day if sustained. Also Dedicated burst from reserved pools hit 75% — might breach SLA allowances if backlog continues.
on-obvious: we need to avoid mass GPU evictions. Suggest: 1) keep rollout paused, 2) revert canary to previous image, 3) throttle scheduling in ap-se1 to reduce queue pressure, 4) force prefault caching in fallback regions to reduce cold-attach costs.
kevin: Agreed. I've set a temporary scheduler cap for ap-se1 (max pending per-pool=4). That should slow the backlog.
siva: Created an incident ticket INC-2025-0457 and added runbook steps. Short checklist in thread:
- Pause rollout (done)
- Manually revert failed canary hosts (in progress)
- Vendor escalation for i2c/watchdog pattern (ticket VND-3621)
- Metric watch: bmc.flash.fail_rate, gpu.provision.latency, cluster.eviction.rate
- Cost watch: billing.alert.cross_region_attach
kevin: For the revert, use command: `oobctl flash --host $HOST --image fw-bmc-2025-02-28 --force-verify` (manual path). Use `--serial-log` to capture.
maria: A quick mitigation we validated on one host: after revert, we applied `ipmitool chassis bootdev none` and a graceful powercycle, then provisioning recovered. Noted in runbook.
elena: We also need a canary tuning: reduce canary batch size from 12->3 and add a health-check hold of 10m. Will open a PR for deploy config.
siva: Vendor response expected in 2-4 hours. If vendor says it's a firmware change we wrote, we'll cut a rollback-patch and stop the next staging push.
oncall-runner: Incident INC-2025-0457 created and pages sent to oncall rotation. Playbook link: https://confluence.redwood/internal/incidents/INC-2025-0457
kevin: If anyone has the csv of affected nodes, drop it here. I'll correlate with provisioning traces.
maria: Uploading quick list: ap-se1-rc3-bmc1, ap-se1-rc3-bmc2, ap-se1-rc4-bmc1, ap-se1-rc7-bmc1.
siva: Adding sticky note: if revert doesn't clear errors within 30m, plan to drain the affected racks and failover workloads to eu-west1. That will be costy but preserves SLOs.
elena: Agreed. Keep status updates short in this thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
